title: IntakeEvent
description: Payload of an intake event in the session log (B10, Q52), validated before it is appended. `kind` equals the event's `type`; the writer checks that relation. Intake is a Ring 0 step (03 Intake): each task is classified once by the deterministic rubric, an owner override is logged with its reason, and the harness may later reclassify only upward.

classified.title: IntakeClassified
classified.description: The rubric classified the task. `scopeSha256` is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the sorted scope (of `[]` when the task declared none), so the class is bound to the exact scope it was computed from.

taskId.$comment: Copy of the task ID pattern of run.ts and event.schema.json's `id`.

reasons.description: Why the rubric chose the class: one reason per rule that fired, in rule order.

scope.description: The declared scope, sorted: repo-relative paths or globs (`*` within a segment, `**` for any number of segments). Empty when the task declared none.

sparring.description: The sparring default the class sets. Only opt-in exists until A5.

costIfWrong.description: What a wrong class would cost, as escaped display text: a misclassification is a ruling the owner can review (03 Intake).

overridden.title: IntakeOverridden
overridden.description: The owner overrode the class from the CLI with a reason. A downward override is approved at the TTY first; the attestation is none until slice SIG.

reason.description: The owner's reason, escaped: not empty and not only spaces.

reclassified.title: IntakeReclassified
reclassified.description: The harness reclassified the task because of a floor signal or the plan-time pass. Upward only (Q52): `to` ranks above `from` (chore < bounded < architectural). The schema cannot express that order, so the harness's upgradeOnly guard enforces it before the event is written.

source.description: `floor`: a structural floor signal. `plan`: the plan-time pass.

signalIds.description: The signals that caused the reclassification.

class.title: IntakeClass
class.description: Task class, in rank order: chore < bounded < architectural.

reason.title: IntakeReason
reason.description: One rule that fired and the entries it fired on, escaped for display. `noDeclaredScope` and `newProcessBoundary` have no entries.

rule.title: IntakeRule
rule.description: Rubric rules: no scope and the declared facts give architectural; Ring 0 paths and entries outside the docs and tests categories give bounded; docs-only and tests-only entries give chore.

declared.title: IntakeDeclared
declared.description: Facts the task declares about its change. Any one of them makes the task architectural.

surfaceChanges.$comment: A bound above 20 keeps the generated type an array, not a union of tuples.

friction.title: IntakeFriction
friction.description: The friction the class sets: `minimal` from the chore downgrade, otherwise the configured default intensity.

attestation.title: IntakeAttestation
attestation.description: Proof of who overrode. Until slice SIG only `none` exists.

entry.description: A declared path, glob, module or dependency: 1 to 1024 characters without control characters.

text.description: Escaped display text, at most 8192 code points.
